messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning to roll the autoscale policy change to dedicated pool polaris-prod tonight at 22:00 PT. This is a config tweak (min_instances 2 -> 4) and a burst-cap bump to allow short surges. Anyone blocked?
Sam: I can take deploy ownership at 22:00 PT. Will be on-call in case rollback needed. :thumbsup: 
Jia: LGTM on config. Will run the smoke tests pre-cutover. I'll run them at 21:40 so we have a 20m buffer.
Mike: Can you paste the exact config snippet you're applying? I want to validate the quota guards.
Alex: Here — applying policy: ```yaml
pool: polaris-prod
autoscale:
  min_instances: 4
  max_instances: 40
  burst_capacity: 8
  scale_in_grace: 60
  scale_out_step: 2
``` 
Alex: Note: change is safe if queue latency stays <100ms. Rollback condition: sustained tail latency >200ms for 5m or errors spike >1%.
Sam: Deploy steps:
1) apply policy to staging-polairs (dry-run)
2) smoke tests (Jia)
3) cutover to polaris-prod with canary traffic 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 10m
I'll post deploy commands in a sec.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy window 22:00 PT — create rollback PR if you need to revert quickly.
Jia: Smoke test commands:
```
# run smoke load generator
./tools/loadgen --pool polaris-staging --qps 10 --duration 3m
# check traces
./tools/check_latency --pool polaris-staging
```
Mike: Two quick asks:
- ensure dedicated alerting has a temporary higher threshold for this roll (avoid noise)
- confirm billing tag is applied so cost spikes are tracked
Alex: Good call. I'll add a short-lived override on the alert policy and add tag `deploy:polaris-autoscale-v2`.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor infra metrics and jump if OOMs or node evictions happen. Ping me if rollout > 22:45 and still ramping.
Sam: Commands to apply (dry-run then apply):
```
# dry-run
rctl autoscale apply --pool polaris-prod --file polaris-autoscale-v2.yaml --dry-run
# apply
rctl autoscale apply --pool polaris-prod --file polaris-autoscale-v2.yaml
```
Sam: I'll do canary at 22:10 after Jia's smoke pass. If canary looks good I'll proceed to full cutover at 22:20.
Jia: Smoke results: staging pass — p95 45ms, error 0.1%. Ready to proceed.
Alex: Awesome. Small reminder: if any service-level regressions surface, revert to autoscale v1 by running:
```
rctl autoscale apply --pool polaris-prod --file polaris-autoscale-v1.yaml
```
Sam: Got it. I'll post a short deploy summary after completion. Thanks team :rocket:
Mike: One post-check — after full cutover, let's watch GPU utilization and KV cache hit rate for 15m.
Alex: Agreed. After 30m we'll decide whether to keep burst_capacity=8 or dial to 6 based on cost.
ops-oncall: Noted. I'll set up a quick dashboard link in the thread during rollout.
Sam: Starting now to stage tasks. Will update with timestamps.
Alex: Thanks all. If anything unexpected, @ops-oncall or @Mike please escalate immediately.
